breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet on all four edges and also periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly omitted the contradictory periodic boundary condition and only included the instruction to apply Dirichlet boundary conditions, thus fixing the error.
